S1.label: Structured data reasoning
S1.description: Fails to parse/cross-reference structured data from tools
S1.notes: Airline: failure to identify correct nonstop route, find matching flight from history, parse flight duration. Retail: failure to cross-reference order contents, find correct product variant, parse item specs.

S2.label: Tool calling precision
S2.notes: Airline: wrong destination in update_reservation, wrong payment method, wrong flight number args. Retail: wrong item_id in exchange, wrong quantity, incorrect modification arguments.

S3.label: Multi-step task completion
S3.notes: Most common failure: agent completes only part of a multi-part request, takes extra unprompted actions, or performs subtasks in wrong order (e.g., returning before exchanging, cancelling wrong reservation).

S4.label: Precondition verification
S4.notes: Airline: acts without checking if reservation is modifiable, if payment method is valid, if compensation policy conditions are met, if cancellation terms apply. Retail: exchanges/returns without checking order status (pending vs delivered), does not verify refund eligibility.

S5.label: Numerical reasoning
S5.notes: Airline: wrong refund amounts, incorrect certificate compensation values, wrong total cost calculations. Retail: miscalculated price differences in exchanges, wrong total refund amounts.

S6.label: Record discovery and retrieval
S6.notes: Airline: looks up wrong user's record, picks wrong flight history, books under wrong identity. Retail: locates wrong order, misidentifies which item belongs to which order, user not found when lookup should succeed.

S7.label: Information communication
S7.description: Right action, fails to state values
S7.notes: Airline: does not communicate required numeric info (balances, amounts, IDs) even after completing the action. Retail: fails to state total refund amounts, specific payment values, or item specs that were explicitly requested.

S8.label: Conditional and state-aware reasoning
S8.description: Ignores if-then or wrong API for state
S8.notes: Airline: ignores conditional instructions (if X do Y else Z), changes a flight to earlier rather than later, cancels a reservation when flight is only delayed. Retail: ignores order state (pending/delivered) when choosing action, ignores conditional cancellation logic, misapplies exchange vs modify based on order state.
